A tool that takes the address by role gets 'address.building' = '79' and 'address.city' = 'мтур'; a passport split into 'passport.series' = '6942'. No needle of the whole value can live in such a leaf: a house or flat number is below MIN_PIECE = 4 (observe.py:75), `city` and `street_type` are exempted by GENERIC_ROLES (observe.py:95), and a digit-typed value's signature is the WHOLE digit string. So the status is `unmasked` forever. Two consequences from one cause. (1) The gateway that does the right thing is scored a miss: 1027 of 7747 declared OUT/tool_arg leaves (13.3 %), touching 504 of 1736 cases, measured with the item's OWN real value and no `own` filter — the most optimistic possible condition. That is the floor under end_to_end (perfect gateway: 6460/7747 = 83.4 %), round_trip (82.5 %), form_hOUT (85.3 %) and multi_all_out, where 504 of 1453 N≥2 turns (34.7 %) hold such a leaf, ceiling ≤ 65.3 %. For a leaf whose role the corpus itself says is not personal data (bare `city`, per ruling R-21), the honest move is to leave it OUT of the OUT denominators rather than count the right behaviour as a miss. Fixtures: a decomposed address whose house leaf carries the fake must be `residual`; the same leaf carrying the real house must be `observed`.
